description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\DefaultsMode namespace. It provides mechanisms to create and retrieve AWS configuration settings, including environment-based, fallback, and INI-file-based configurations. The class offers methods to generate default providers, chain multiple providers, handle caching, and unwrap configuration objects, serving as an integral part of AWS SDK configuration management.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A class that offers static methods to create AWS configuration providers using environment variables, INI files, fallback options, or chaining multiple providers. It supports caching and unwrapping configuration promises to a standard configuration interface.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, configuration files, and fallback options, with optional caching based on provided parameters.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a provider function that retrieves AWS configuration mode from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when no other sources are available.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a provider function that loads configuration from a specified INI file and profile.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps various forms of configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
